title.zh: Fed stablecoin research exposes how the same dollar could count twice in M1 or M2
title.en: Fed stablecoin research exposes how the same dollar could count twice in M1 or M2

current_state.zh: A Federal Reserve staff note outlines how regulated payment stablecoins could enter M1/M2 money supply measures, requiring adjustments to avoid double-counting reserves and separating US from global circulation.
